specialRules.name: Variant identity
specialRules.summary: Town Cryer 15 Lustria list; distinct from the existing Amazons (Mordheim) list with Priestess, Champions, Totem Warriors and Scouts. Do not replace its types or equipment.

specialRules.name: Recruitment
specialRules.summary: Start with 500 gc and at least three models, including exactly one Serpent Priestess and at least one Amazon Warrior. Henchwomen groups contain 1–5 models.

specialRules.name: Isolationists
specialRules.summary: Reroll missed attacks in the first combat round against Lizardmen and Norse.

specialRules.name: Sacrifice
specialRules.summary: Handle captives as the Possessed do. Sacrificing a captured Lizardman also grants free Skins and Charms.

specialRules.name: Norse Enmity
specialRules.summary: Against Norse, reroll the first failed Rout test; voluntary routing is forbidden while the leader remains in action.

specialRules.name: Not one of us
specialRules.summary: Only Amazon Hired Swords and Dramatis Personae may join; no alliance with outsiders.

specialRules.name: Magic sources
specialRules.summary: Amazon Rituals are detailed at https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/amazon-rituals. Standard wizard casting restrictions apply.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.summary: Starts with one random Amazon Ritual.

warriors.name: Amazon Warriors
warriors.conditionText: At least one Amazon Warrior is required. Scope this type to the Lustria variant rather than replacing the existing Mordheim type.

specialRules.name: One with the Jungle
specialRules.summary: Ignore movement penalties for jungle terrain.

items.name: Starblade
items.ruleText: User Strength; opponent gains +1 armour save. May parry the first successful combat hit on 4+.

items.name: Starsword
items.ruleText: User Strength +1; parry; ignore armour, but not ward or dodge saves.

items.name: Sunstaff (Lustria)
items.ruleText: User Strength in melee. Fires a 12-inch S4 sunbolt; ignores armour and long-range penalties, but ward and dodge saves apply. Not the Mordheim Sunstaff profile.

items.name: Enchanted Skins
items.ruleText: 6+ special save against wounds and ignore enemy magic on 5+; also called Skins and Charms.

items.name: Amulet of the Moon
items.ruleText: Enemy missile attacks suffer -1 to hit; wearer has a 5+ special save against missiles.

items.name: Healing Herbs
items.ruleText: Listed as fixed-price miscellaneous recruitment equipment in the Heroines list. Apply existing Healing Herbs rules; not a weapon or equipment set.

items.name: Sunstaff (Lustria)
items.ruleText: User Strength in melee; 12-inch S4 sunbolt ignores armour and long-range penalties, not ward/dodge saves.

items.name: Enchanted Skins
items.ruleText: 6+ special wound save; ignore enemy magic on 5+.

items.name: Bolas
items.ruleText: 16-inch range, once per battle, recovered afterward. A hit prevents movement and gives -2 WS; free oneself on 4+ in Recovery. Natural 1 to hit causes an S3 hit on the thrower.

items.ruleText: User Strength in melee; 12-inch S4 sunbolt ignores armour and long-range penalties, not ward/dodge saves.

items.ruleText: Rare 8; Piranha Warriors only. At game start reroll deployment order and first-turn determination. Multiple horns cannot force further rerolls.

skills.name: Skink Hunter
skills.summary: Always strike first in the first combat round against Skinks, irrespective of the charger.

skills.name: Elixir of Life
skills.summary: Reroll one Serious Injury roll after a battle; accept the replacement.

skills.name: Mesmerising Dance
skills.summary: At each turn's start, enemies in base contact test Leadership or cannot attack that turn, though they defend normally. Lizardmen and Undead are unaffected.

skills.name: Savage Fury
skills.summary: +1 Attack when charging; immune to fear and charm effects.

skills.name: Concealment
skills.summary: When hiding in jungle, halve enemy spotting ranges.

spellDisciplines.name: Amazon Rituals
spellDisciplines.castingRuleSummary: Wizard: one spell each Shooting phase, passing its difficulty on 2D6; cannot also shoot. Standard armour/shield/buckler restrictions apply. Source: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/amazon-rituals.

spells.name: Singing Wind
spells.effectSummary: Hold a model within 10 inches until the caster's next turn: no movement, shooting or spellcasting; it can defend in melee but strikes last.

spells.name: Serpent’s Strength
spells.effectSummary: Friendly models within 8 inches, including caster, gain +1 S until the end of their next turn. Cannot cast while in melee; entering melee afterward does not cancel it.

spells.name: Wendala’s Maelstrom
spells.effectSummary: An 18-inch storm around the Priestess gives enemy missile fire -1 to hit until the Amazon player's next turn.

spells.name: Shield of Thorns
spells.effectSummary: Caster becomes immune to ranged and magical attacks. Charging enemies may engage, but neither side strikes in the first combat round. Cannot cast in melee; duration is not specified.

spells.name: The Living Jungle
spells.effectSummary: One model within 12 inches takes D6 S2 hits; only ward saves apply, not armour or dodge.

spells.name: Siren’s Dreams
spells.effectSummary: Distracts enemies within 12 inches; the opposing warband makes Leadership tests at -1 until the end of its next turn. Lizardmen and Undead are immune.

spellAccess.selectionRule: Random D6 ritual at recruitment; normal wizard advancement.

specialRules.name: Enemy armour
specialRules.summary: Target gains +1 to armour save.

specialRules.name: Potential Parry
specialRules.summary: May parry the first successful combat hit on 4+.

specialRules.name: Parry
specialRules.summary: May parry enemy blows.

specialRules.name: Ignores Armour
specialRules.summary: Ignore armour saves, but not ward or dodge saves.

weaponProfiles.notes: Dual-mode Lustria weapon, not the existing Mordheim Sunstaff.

specialRules.name: Dangerous
specialRules.summary: Natural 1 to hit causes an S3 hit on thrower.

specialRules.name: Entangle
specialRules.summary: Hit causes no damage but prevents movement and gives -2 WS. Shooting remains possible. A 4+ Recovery roll frees the target.

specialRules.name: Limited use
specialRules.summary: Use once per battle; recovered automatically afterward.

armourProfiles.name: Enchanted Skins (Lustria)

specialRules.name: Magic protection
specialRules.summary: Ignore enemy magic on 5+.

armourProfiles.notes: Also called Skins and Charms; no ordinary armour save specified.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: Only Amazon Hired Swords or Dramatis Personae are permitted. No exact qualifying hire names are supplied by this source; do not inherit the broad existing Amazons hire list.

specialRules.name: Recruitment
specialRules.summary: 500 gc initially; minimum three models and exactly one Black Orc Boss. Henchmen groups have 1–5 members.

specialRules.name: Let the goons do the work
specialRules.summary: Black Orcs cannot ride mounts; ordinary Orcs can.

specialRules.name: Da Boss is Dead!
specialRules.summary: A Black Orc takes leadership before any other type, regardless of experience; the replacement gains Oi Behave!.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Unengaged Orc/Goblin henchmen test each turn: D6 result 1 triggers a second roll. Second roll 1 attacks the nearest eligible friendly Orc/Goblin henchman or Hired Sword by charge or shot, then combatants separate by 1 inch; otherwise lose the turn. Results 2–5 lose the turn. Result 6 moves toward the nearest visible enemy, charging if possible, or grants a normal extra move if none is visible; charge in normal movement if brought within range.

specialRules.name: Animosity source conflict
specialRules.summary: Boyz/Shootaz entries say Leadership test, but the referenced Annual chart triggers on a D6 result of 1. The source flags this discrepancy; resolve manually, not as an invented extra Leadership check.

specialRules.name: Animosity friendly-Hero exception
specialRules.summary: On the attack-friend result, if the nearest friendly model is an Orc Hero, use the lost-turn result instead. Do not simply select a more distant eligible henchman.

specialRules.name: Shootaz balance
specialRules.summary: Shootaz cannot outnumber Boyz when hired. If casualties upset the balance, the next hire must be a Boy.

specialRules.name: Black Orc
specialRules.summary: Natural 6+ armour save, cumulative with equipment.

specialRules.name: Oi Behave!
specialRules.summary: When a henchman within 6 inches fails Animosity, optionally hit it automatically at a chosen Strength. If it remains standing, add that Strength to its Animosity-effect roll.

specialRules.name: Black Orc
specialRules.summary: Natural 6+ armour save, cumulative with equipment.

specialRules.name: Black Orc Blood
specialRules.summary: One Young'un may be upgraded for +10 gc, making him eligible for Proven Warrior at 25 experience. This is an upgrade within the two Young'uns, not an extra hero.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity; see the warband's noted D6/Leadership wording conflict.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity; see the warband's wording conflict.

specialRules.name: Uncommon
specialRules.summary: May not hire more Shootaz than Boyz; after excess caused by Boy casualties, next hire must restore the balance with a Boy.

specialRules.name: Unstable
specialRules.summary: Do not test Animosity.

specialRules.name: Crazy
specialRules.summary: Automatically pass Leadership-based tests; if promoted, never learn Academic skills.

specialRules.name: Savage
specialRules.summary: Run or charge maximally toward the nearest visible enemy; friendly models do not block sight. Gain +1 Attack in combat, outside the profile/racial cap. No visible enemy allows normal player control. Never use armour or ranged weapons. Cannot gain Leader or supply Rout Leadership unless only Nuttaz remain on the board.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.summary: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Stupidity
specialRules.summary: Subject to stupidity.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.summary: Ignore wounds on 4+, except fire. No post-battle Injury roll unless fire took it out of action; then use normal henchman injuries.

specialRules.name: Dumb Monster
specialRules.summary: Never gains experience.

specialRules.name: Always Hungry
specialRules.summary: Pay 20 gc upkeep after each battle. Alternatively count it as two members and pay 5 gc, effectively leaving room for only eleven physical models.

specialRules.name: Vomit Attack
specialRules.summary: Instead of normal attacks, make one automatic S5 hit ignoring armour.

specialRules.name: Large Target
specialRules.summary: Large shooting target.

items.name: Choppa
items.ruleText: Counts as a morning star.

items.name: Choppa
items.ruleText: Counts as a morning star.

skills.name: Proven Warrior
skills.summary: Requires Black Orc Blood and 25 experience. Retain the Young'un title but become a full Black Orc: its rules, equipment and skill access now apply.

skills.name: ’Ard Ead
skills.summary: 3+ save converts stunned to knocked down; 2+ with a helmet, replacing the normal helmet save.

skills.name: Waaagh!
skills.summary: Add D3 inches to charge range.

skills.name: ’Ere We Go!
skills.summary: Ignore fear tests when charging.

skills.name: Da Cunnin’ Plan
skills.summary: Boss only: reroll failed Rout tests while he is not out of action.

skills.name: ’Eadbasher
skills.summary: Melee injuries inflicted as knocked down become stunned.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: The supplied Black Orc source gives no complete hire whitelist. Eligibility remains unresolved; do not automatically inherit Orc or unrestricted hires.

specialRules.name: Don’t Trust ‘Em
specialRules.summary: May ally with other Dwarf warbands, but neither treats the other's members as friendly: they block marching and do not prevent All Alone tests. They are not enemies and can split treasure.

specialRules.name: Hard to Kill
specialRules.summary: Injury rolls: 1–2 knocked down, 3–5 stunned, 6 out of action.

specialRules.name: Hard Head
specialRules.summary: Ignore the concussion special rules of clubs, maces and similar weapons.

specialRules.name: Armour
specialRules.summary: No movement penalties from armour.

specialRules.name: Hate Orcs and Goblins
specialRules.summary: All Dwarfs hate Orcs and Goblins.

specialRules.name: Grudgebearers
specialRules.summary: No Elven Hired Sword or Dramatis Persona may join.

specialRules.name: Incomparable Miners
specialRules.summary: Add one to the number of wyrdstone pieces found after a battle.

specialRules.name: No Arcane Lore
specialRules.summary: Dwarfs cannot take Arcane Lore or become spellcasters. Academic access does not override this.

specialRules.name: Stronghold prices
specialRules.summary: Listed Gromril weapon triple prices and 75 gc Gromril armour apply only to a starting warband. Later purchases use normal Trading Post prices.

specialRules.name: Gromril weapon scope
specialRules.summary: Source permits any normally purchasable weapon to be Gromril but supplies no ranged-specific effect. Ranged Gromril variants below reflect that literal clause, not a new ranged armour-piercing rule.

specialRules.name: Inscribe Runes
specialRules.summary: Knows one random minor rune initially. Before a game attempt inscription on one carried item; with an Apprentice, attempt two items. On a skill advance may learn a rune instead.

specialRules.name: Extra Set of Hands
specialRules.summary: Allows the master Runesmith to inscribe two items before each game instead of one; does not grant independent rune casting.

specialRules.name: Deathwish

specialRules.name: Slayer Special Skills
specialRules.summary: May also select Ferocious Charge, Monster Slayer and Berserker from the Slayer-only list, in addition to common Dwarf skills.

specialRules.name: Stubborn
specialRules.summary: Reroll any failed Leadership test once, accepting the replacement.

skills.name: Combat Master
skills.summary: Parry on matching or beating the highest enemy hit die. With two parrying weapons, may parry two attacks by matching/beating the two highest dice.

skills.name: Extra Tough
skills.summary: Reroll the post-battle Serious Injury roll once; accept the replacement.

skills.name: Resource Hunter
skills.summary: Modify one Exploration die by +1 or -1.

skills.name: True Grit
skills.summary: Injury results: 1–3 knocked down, 4–5 stunned, 6 out of action.

skills.name: Thick Skull
skills.summary: 3+ save turns stunned into knocked down; with helmet use 2+, replacing the normal helmet rule.

skills.name: Ferocious Charge
skills.summary: Double Attacks on a charge, with -1 to hit that turn.

skills.name: Monster Slayer
skills.summary: Wound on 4+ regardless of enemy Toughness, unless normal Strength/weapon rules allow a better result.

skills.name: Berserker
skills.summary: +1 to hit on the turn the Slayer charges.

spellDisciplines.name: Dwarf Runes
spellDisciplines.castingRuleSummary: Not wizard magic. Before each game roll 2D6 against difficulty to inscribe a known rune on a warrior's carried item. Success lasts that game only. Natural 2 destroys the item (replaceable before play); other failure gives no benefit. One item normally, two with an Apprentice. Rune bonuses cannot combine with other rune or magical-item bonuses.

spells.name: Rune of Stone
spells.effectSummary: +1 armour save.

spells.name: Rune of Sharpness
spells.effectSummary: Weapon adds -1 to enemy armour saves.

spells.name: Rune of Speed
spells.effectSummary: Weapon doubles Initiative.

spells.name: Rune of Warding
spells.effectSummary: 4+ special save against spells affecting the wearer; inscribe on belt/armband or similar, replacement cost 1 gc.

spells.name: Rune of Accuracy
spells.effectSummary: Weapon gives +1 to hit.

spells.name: Rune of Striding
spells.effectSummary: +1 Movement; inscribe on boots/belt or similar, replacement cost 1 gc.

spellAccess.selectionRule: Random minor rune at recruitment; may learn another instead of a skill on a skill advance. Apprentice assists but receives no independent rune access.

specialRules.name: Cutting Edge
specialRules.summary: Extra -1 to enemy armour save.

specialRules.name: Parry
specialRules.summary: Beat highest enemy hit die to cancel one attack; cannot parry attacks of at least twice own Strength. Two parrying weapons allow a failed-parry reroll, not two parries absent Combat Master.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: Grudgebearers excludes every Elven Hired Sword or Dramatis Persona, not just these known names. Source does not supply a complete positive hire whitelist; do not infer one.

specialRules.name: Recruitment
specialRules.summary: Start with 500 gc, at least three models and exactly one Chieftain. Up to four Braves plus one Shaman fit the six-Hero limit; henchmen groups have 1–5 models.

specialRules.name: Natives
specialRules.summary: Forest Goblins ignore movement penalties in wooded terrain.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Unengaged Goblin henchmen, and Braves by their own rule, test each turn: D6 result 1 triggers another roll. Second roll 1 attacks nearest eligible friendly Orc/Goblin henchman or Hired Sword by charge/shot, separates combatants by 1 inch afterward, and prevents further actions; if no suitable target, lose the turn. Results 2–5 lose the turn. Result 6 moves toward nearest visible enemy, charging when possible; with no enemy visible grants an extra normal move. Must charge in normal movement if the extra move brings an enemy into range.

specialRules.name: Animosity friendly-Hero exception
specialRules.summary: The reproduced Annual chart says that a nearest friendly Orc Hero changes the attack-friend result to losing the turn. It does not expressly extend this wording to Goblin Heroes; do not invent that extension.

specialRules.name: Special equipment availability
specialRules.summary: Magic Gubbinz, poisoned-weapon upgrades, jewellery and riding Giant Spiders are Trading Post equipment, not additions to starting lists. A riding Giant Spider is distinct from the Gigantic Spider henchman and cannot coexist with Giant Wolves.

specialRules.name: Magic sources
specialRules.summary: Forest Goblin Magic: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/forest-goblin-magic. Ordinary wizard rules apply.

specialRules.name: Ride Spiders
specialRules.summary: May ride Giant Spiders and the Gigantic Spider using Blazing Saddles rules.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity despite being Heroes.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.summary: Starts with one randomly determined Forest Goblin spell.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity except when Berserkers exempts them.

specialRules.name: Berserkers
specialRules.summary: Frenzy; ignore Animosity when beginning the turn within charge range of an enemy.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.summary: Subject to Animosity.

specialRules.name: Sluggas
specialRules.summary: May fire thrown weapons up to three times in Shooting. Cannot combine this with Quick Shot after promotion.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.summary: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Large Monster
specialRules.summary: Large target; may always be shot at.

specialRules.name: Poisonous
specialRules.summary: When its wound causes an injury: 1 knocked down, 2–4 stunned, 5–6 out of action.

specialRules.name: Native
specialRules.summary: Ignore wooded-terrain movement penalties.

specialRules.name: Non-sentient
specialRules.summary: Stupidity; never gains experience; may climb normally.

specialRules.name: May Ride
specialRules.summary: Chieftain may ride it, gaining +1 armour save and using M6. Shooting hits rider on 1–2, spider on 3–6. Melee attacker chooses target. While ridden it does not test stupidity.

items.name: Boss Pole
items.ruleText: User and Goblin henchmen within 6 inches ignore Animosity. Spear in melee.

items.name: Blowpipe
items.ruleText: 8 inches, S1; natural 6 to hit wounds automatically; no criticals. Target receives +1 armour save (6+ if none). May fire while hidden; target passes Initiative to reveal shooter.

items.name: Blowpipe
items.ruleText: 8 inches, S1; natural hit 6 auto-wounds, no criticals; +1 target armour save (6+ if none). Hidden shooting only reveals user if target passes Initiative.

equipmentLists.name: Trading Post Special Equipment (not starting equipment)

items.name: Magic Gubbinz
items.ruleText: Trading Post only, Rare 9. On 4+ may reroll a failed magic test.

items.name: Poisoned Weapon
items.ruleText: Trading Post only, Common; +25 gc permanent upgrade to one existing weapon, not a separate weapon. +1 to its Injury rolls; cannot later trade or sell it.

items.name: Red Toof Tribal Jewellery
items.ruleText: Trading Post only, Rare 9. Cannot remove; wearer gains Frenzy.

items.name: Giant Spider
items.ruleText: Trading Post riding animal, Rare 11, Goblins only; incompatible with Giant Wolves. M7 WS3 BS0 S3(4) T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld4. Poison treats attacks as S4 without modifying armour. Rider/spider walk walls without Initiative tests; jumps at most 2 inches across/down, allowing diving charges, and rider tests Initiative or rolls Whoa Boy! Chieftain has explicit riding permission.

skills.name: Remove Animosity
skills.summary: A Brave may remove his Animosity instead of choosing a skill on a skill advance; this is the table's only Special entry, not broad Orc special-skill access.

spellDisciplines.name: Forest Goblin Magic
spellDisciplines.castingRuleSummary: Standard wizard casting: one spell in Shooting, pass difficulty on 2D6, no simultaneous missile shot or casting with armour/shield/buckler. Source: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/forest-goblin-magic.

spells.name: Wind of Gork
spells.effectSummary: 12 inches; first model in the path must roll under its Toughness or take an S2 hit and automatically be knocked down.

spells.name: Gaze of Mork
spells.effectSummary: 12 inches; first model in the path takes D3 S3 hits.

spells.name: ‘Eadbanger
spells.effectSummary: 6 inches; fire bolts equal to caster's Attacks, each at Strength equal to caster's Toughness, at first model in path. After resolution, D6 result 1 takes caster out of action.

spells.name: Leap of Waaagh!
spells.effectSummary: Move caster or one Goblin within 3 inches up to 12 inches; entry into combat counts as a charge.

spells.name: Idol of Gork
spells.effectSummary: Caster gains +1 WS, S and A until suffering a wound.

spells.name: ‘Ere we go
spells.effectSummary: Friendly models within 6 inches treat stunned as knocked down until caster suffers a wound.

spellAccess.selectionRule: Random D6 spell at recruitment; normal wizard advancement.

specialRules.name: Spear
specialRules.summary: Strike first in first combat round; only shield or buckler in other hand. Mounted charge gains +1 S when using mounted rules.

specialRules.name: Ignore Animosity
specialRules.summary: Bearer and Goblin henchmen within 6 inches ignore Animosity.

specialRules.name: Poison
specialRules.summary: Natural hit 6 wounds automatically; no critical hits.

specialRules.name: Enemy armour
specialRules.summary: +1 enemy armour save; 6+ if target normally has none.

specialRules.name: Stealthy
specialRules.summary: Firing while hidden does not reveal shooter unless target passes an Initiative test.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: The supplied Forest Goblin source does not give a complete hire whitelist. Do not silently assign unrestricted or inherited Orc eligibility.

specialRules.name: Recruitment
specialRules.summary: 500 warp tokens initially; minimum three models and exactly one Plague Priest. One Sorcerer, two Monks and two Initiates are separate limits, not mutually exclusive choices.

specialRules.name: Pestilens substitutes
specialRules.summary: Clan Pestilens Banner replaces normal Banner; fog-enhancing shards replace Elven Cloak; Liber Bubonicus replaces Tome of Magic; Liturgicus Infecticus replaces War horn; Scroll of the Rat Familiar replaces Familiar; Warpstone Amulet replaces Rabbit's Foot.

specialRules.name: Trade-only costs
specialRules.summary: Special equipment outside the starting lists is acquired from Trading Post. For variable prices, unitCost records only the fixed base; ruleText gives the mandatory full roll formula. Do not treat the base as the final price.

specialRules.name: Magic sources
specialRules.summary: Horned Rat spells: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/magic-of-the-horned-rat. Initial one random spell and standard wizard restrictions: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic.

specialRules.name: Liber skill-name conflict
specialRules.summary: Source names Magical Aptitude for a Priest learning magic with Liber Bubonicus; editorial note identifies Arcane Lore as the intended Tome-of-Magic equivalent. Record the conflict for manual adjudication.

specialRules.name: Conditional spellcasting
specialRules.summary: Not initially a wizard. Liber Bubonicus plus the required Academic skill can grant one random Horned Rat spell and spellcasting; see the recorded skill-name conflict.

specialRules.name: Spellcaster
specialRules.summary: Uses Magic of the Horned Rat.

specialRules.name: Experience
specialRules.summary: Animals; never gain experience.

warriors.name: Rat Familiar

specialRules.name: Enchanted Animal
specialRules.summary: Gains henchman experience. Advancement 10–12 gives a cumulative +1 to its Sorcerer's casting rolls when within 6 inches, instead of promotion.

specialRules.name: Rat Familiar
specialRules.summary: Within 6 inches lets its Sorcerer reroll one casting-difficulty roll per game. Counts as a normal warband member; reverts to a Giant Rat if its Sorcerer dies.

warriors.conditionText: Not directly recruitable as a Familiar. Transform an existing 15 gc Giant Rat before battle using a Scroll of the Rat Familiar; scroll price is additional. One per Sorcerer; no weapons or armour.

items.name: Disease Dagger
items.ruleText: Natural hit 6 forces target Toughness test; failure causes an extra wound. Undead/Possessed immune. Normal dagger armour bonus applies; two grant only normal extra-weapon attack.

items.name: Censer
items.ruleText: Two hands; +2 S only in first melee round. Each hit forces target Toughness test (6 always fails) for an extra wound; wielder also tests but only suffers on 6. Undead/Possessed ignore fumes. Fog-enhancing shards give -1 to enemy missile hits against bearer. Censer Bearer skill restricts its user's melee equipment; the starting list does not require that skill merely to buy a censer.

items.name: Censer

items.name: Disease Dagger

items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 5. One per warband. Allies within 12 inches reroll failed All Alone tests once. Staff is a two-handed weapon; replaces normal Banner.

items.name: Fog-enhancing Warpstone Shards
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 9; full price 100 + D6 × 10 gc. With a censer, enemy missile shots at bearer suffer -1 to hit; replaces Elven Cloak.

items.name: Liber Bubonicus
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 12; full price 200 + D6 × 25 gc. One book/use per campaign. Sorcerer permanently learns a random Horned Rat spell; Priest with Magical Aptitude (editorial note: Arcane Lore) instead gains spellcasting and one random spell. Replaces Tome of Magic.

items.name: Liturgicus Infecticus
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 8; full price 30 + 2D6 gc. Chant at turn start or just before Rout test for +1 warband Leadership until end of turn; replaces War horn.

items.name: Vial of Pestilens
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 9; full price 25 + 2D6 gc. Once, when bearer is taken out of action, use against the responsible enemy in base contact: failed Toughness test takes enemy out of action with no save and leaves bearer stunned instead.

items.name: Scroll of the Rat Familiar
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 8; full price 25 + D6 gc. Reusable before-battle enchantment transforms one existing Giant Rat into a Rat Familiar. One Familiar per Sorcerer; see conditional warrior entry. Replaces normal Familiar.

items.name: Warpstone Amulet
items.ruleText: Trading Post Rare 5. Reroll one die during battle, or one exploration die if bearer is not out of action; replaces Rabbit's Foot.

items.name: Skeleton Chariot
items.ruleText: Maximum one; full price 200 + 10D6 gc. Classification and warband-member counting unresolved; misc records it for manual adjudication, not as an ordinary fixed-price purchase. Chariot profile M- WS- BS- S4 T4 W3 I- A- Ld-; each of two steeds M8 WS2 BS2 S3 T3 W1 I2 A1 Ld5. Mount/dismount as ridden steed. M8, no running; charge doubles move but requires Drive Chariot. Difficult ground causes D3 S4 hits, or 2D3 S6 on charge. One dead steed halves movement/charge and removes impacts; both dead immobilize chariot, rider fights on foot. Charge any visible enemy in open, not necessarily nearest. Moving over half normal move permits impacts on models in path: victims may dodge by Initiative; rider rolls to hit, dealing one S4 wound at -2 armour. Rider then fights normally. Melee attacker may target driver/chariot; chariot uses driver WS; contact only with steed permits only steed attacks. Large shooting target (+1 to hit); random hit allocation 1–2 steed, 3–4 chariot, 5–6 driver. Tomb Lord lacks Academic access to learn Drive Chariot; do not fabricate an exception.

skills.name: Drive Chariot
skills.summary: Required to charge while driving a chariot. No skill means it cannot charge. Tomb Lord has no Academic access in the source.

spellDisciplines.name: Mortuary Cult Scrolls
spellDisciplines.castingRuleSummary: Ancient scroll incantations cast as normal wizard spells: Shooting phase, 2D6 difficulty, one per turn; no missile shot or casting in armour/shield/buckler. Source: https://mordheimer.net/docs/magic/mortuary-cult-scrolls.

spells.name: Menkare's scroll of Urgency
spells.effectSummary: One Skeleton Soldier within 6 inches immediately moves up to its M4 again; reaching base contact counts as charging.

spells.name: Horrebe's Curse of the Mummy

spells.name: Tawosret's Scroll of Tomb Dust

spells.name: Neferre's Scroll of Quaking Horror

spells.name: Merneptah's Scroll of the Scarab Song
